pay_ids = pay['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
status = pay['Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
paid_mask = status == 'paid'
# filter payments where beneficiary id in ben set
ben_set = set(ben_ids)
pay_filtered = pay[paid_mask & pay_ids.isin(ben_set)].copy()
pay_filtered['Beneficiary ID'] = pay_filtered['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
unique_paid_bens = set(pay_filtered['Beneficiary ID'].unique())
total_bens = len(ben_set)
pct = len(unique_paid_bens) / total_bens * 100
print('total beneficiaries', total_bens)
print('unique paid', len(unique_paid_bens))

\""
